purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Sa`dah

queries.query: Sa'dah Yemen cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official General Authority for Land, Survey and Urban Planning (GALSUP) website and official Yemen legal text describing the real-estate registry, including parcel records and attached maps. GALSUP material references a Sa'dah branch and urban master-planning work, but no public parcel vector viewer or API was found.

queries.query: صعدة اليمن خريطة عقارية السجل العقاري هيئة الأراضي والمساحة والتخطيط العمراني
queries.result: Arabic first-party discovery identified the official GALSUP site, its official Telegram publication describing the Sa'dah branch and city master plan, and the official legal registry text. The current GALSUP website is a WordPress informational site; inspected HTML/current scripts exposed no public map, GIS, ArcGIS, WFS, or parcel JSON route.

registryEvidence: A local registry/cadastre custodian is evidenced by Yemen's official General Authority for Land, Survey and Urban Planning and its official publication specifically discussing the Sa'dah branch and the city's urban master plan. This establishes institutional/local procedure evidence, not open machine-readable parcel coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official GALSUP website reachable over default TLS. Current HTML and linked assets were inspected; no public parcel map/API route was exposed.
Official GALSUP Telegram publication identifies work at the Sa'dah branch and preparation/update of the Sa'dah city master plan, including neighborhood units and agricultural-land protection.

Official Yemen Public Prosecution legal-text page describes the real-estate registry, individual property records, parcel numbers, boundaries, area, and attached property maps; it is legal/procedural evidence rather than a parcel service.

source: Yemen General Authority for Land, Survey and Urban Planning (GALSUP); Yemen official real-estate-registry legal text

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-default GET succeeded with HTTP 200. Current page HTML and linked JavaScript/assets were inspected; no public parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was identified.
The WordPress REST discovery URL was observed in the official page headers; no parcel layer was exposed or queried.
Official channel page was reachable through first-party discovery and documented the Sa'dah branch/master-plan context; no parcel data or map API was exposed.
Official legal-text page was identified through first-party discovery; it describes registry/map procedure but returns no parcel feature response.

schemaAndCrs.observedService: GALSUP informational website and official registry legal text
schemaAndCrs.qualification: Not qualified as a parcel layer: no parcel-level geometry, schema, CRS, or safe native parcel identity was obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sa'dah local branch and Yemen national land/survey/urban-planning institutional sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Institutional/local registry and planning evidence only. Citywide parcel coverage and anonymous parcel-vector access were not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
remainingUncertainty: GALSUP or a branch-mediated workflow may expose cadastral maps or parcel records outside the public website, and conflict/security conditions may affect availability. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or other unsafe field was requested or retained. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
